name: Mark
summary: A gentle, sweet tripod boy. Neutered, fully vaccinated and dewormed, hoping for a home abroad.
story:
For 29 days, Mark was lying on the street and nobody helped him. Only one man came by to feed him, and Mark had to drag himself along the ground.

Someone had shot him with a pump-action gun. The bullet went deep into his thigh bone and broke it. We did everything we could to save his leg, but sadly we couldn't.

Today Mark is a tripod dog, and he walks just fine on three legs. He is very gentle and sweet, and his colors are so unusual and lovely.

Mark is neutered, fully vaccinated and dewormed. We hope to find him a loving home abroad.
